us_election.reading: consolidation — AI held as a strategic asset, access to allies rationed from Washington

events.title: Medicine Delivers
events.description: Treatments arrive for diseases previously untreatable, or individually tailored therapies reach ordinary clinical use. It moves `public_sentiment` sharply upward – unless the models delivering it are ones the Union cannot access on its own terms, in which case the benefit arrives as a further demonstration of dependence and moves sentiment much less.

events.title: Open Weights Reach the Frontier
events.description: An open-weight release lands within months of the closed frontier rather than a year. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

portfolio.name: Open Science Resilience Initiative
portfolio.description: Establish a pan-European network of public research institutes and open-weight developers focused on high-assurance, auditable AI systems for biosecurity, climate modelling, and critical infrastructure resilience, with guaranteed deployment pathways into EU agencies and member state operations` — finished

portfolio.name: Sovereign Compute Backbone
portfolio.description: Establish a legally anchored, militarily protected, and publicly governed AI compute infrastructure on EU soil, capable of training and running auditable frontier-equivalent models independently of foreign providers` — in flight

portfolio.name: Public Accountability Migration Programme
portfolio.description: Migrate high-impact, high-exposure public services — starting with social insurance, healthcare eligibility, and border processing — from opaque or externally dependent AI systems to auditable models running on sovereign infrastructure` — in flight
